helpIntro: Johns Hopkins Homewood undergraduates use a 4.0 credit-weighted GPA. Enter Hopkins credits and final grades; A+ and A are both 4.0, while F counts as zero and S/U does not enter GPA.
helpNote: For full-time on-campus KSAS/WSE undergraduates. Peabody and other JHU divisions can use different grading systems. The repeat tool is only for an eligible Homewood course originally graded C+ or lower; ethics-violation grades and unresolved repeats need manual review.
helpExample: A 4-credit A earns 16.0 grade points and a 3-credit B+ earns 9.9. Together, 25.9 ÷ 7 = 3.700.

gradeExplanations.A+: Excellent; A+ is 4.0, the same GPA value as A.
gradeExplanations.C+: Satisfactory; eligible original grade for the standard retake policy.
gradeExplanations.C: Satisfactory; eligible original grade for the standard retake policy.
gradeExplanations.C-: Satisfactory; eligible original grade for the standard retake policy.
gradeExplanations.D+: Passing; eligible original grade for the standard retake policy.
gradeExplanations.D: Passing; eligible original grade for the standard retake policy.
gradeExplanations.F: Failure; credits count in GPA at zero points; eligible original grade for standard retake.
gradeExplanations.S: Satisfactory in an S/U course; no GPA effect.
gradeExplanations.U: Unsatisfactory in an S/U course; no GPA effect and no credit.
gradeExplanations.I: Incomplete is temporary and does not affect GPA until replaced by the final/reversion grade.
gradeExplanations.MR: Missing grade roster; no final grade available for calculation.
gradeExplanations.MT: Multi-term notation; wait for the final grade.
gradeExplanations.NG: No grade given, course completed; no grade-point value published for GPA calculation.
gradeExplanations.X: No grade reported by instructor; wait for a final grade.
gradeExplanations.FEV: Failure for an ethics violation; the sanction grade remains in GPA and cannot be absolved by repeating.

specialTypes.name: Homewood KSAS/WSE course
specialTypes.note: Enter Hopkins credits and the finalized Homewood grade.

specialTypes.name: Approved external transfer credit
specialTypes.note: Transfer grades do not appear on the Hopkins record and do not enter the Hopkins GPA.

specialTypes.name: Study abroad / external program
specialTypes.note: Program and course posting rules vary. Confirm the transcript notation and GPA treatment before calculating.

specialTypes.name: Other JHU division course
specialTypes.note: Other JHU divisions can use different grade scales and policies. Confirm how the course posts to the Homewood record.

repeatPolicy.note: For an eligible C+ or lower course, the completed second attempt replaces the original in GPA and credit even if the new grade is lower. Do not use Repeat Impact for ethics-violation grades or an uncompleted/withdrawn repeat.
